segments.name: Automotive retail
segments.description: Sells new and used vehicles through auto dealerships and facilitates automotive financing for car buyers.
segments.evidence: The Group operates and manages its business as a single segment.

revenueModel.text: Car buyers pay the company for retail sales of new and used vehicles through its dealerships.
revenueModel.evidence: As part of our business, we offer retail auto sales of new and used vehicles

changes.text: In February 2023 the Group sold its Zhejiang Taohaoche equity interest, which was not treated as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: The transfer of share equity interest in Zhejiang Taohaoche did not constitute a strategic shift of the Group's operations and did not have major effects on the Group's operations and financial results; therefore, the transactions do not meet the discontinued operations criteria.
